why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open swanusd.com/airdrop from a link you typed yourself and enter your Ethereum address in the checker. If it is not listed, it cannot qualify for the launch pool.
Stake a little over 1,000 swanUSD to get at least 1,000 sSwanUSD.
Optionally deposit the sSwanUSD in SWAN-rewards staking. It still counts for the airdrop and also earns SWAN emissions.
Keep at least 1,000 sSwanUSD for 7 full days. Start no later than 12 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Watch @MonolithMarket for the claim date, then claim before the expiry. Monolith says it never sends DMs first, so ignore anyone who messages you with a claim link.
costs: There is no entry fee, but you need about $1,000 or more in sSwanUSD locked up for at least 7 days, and every step pays Ethereum mainnet gas: minting or swapping, staking, depositing and claiming. If you mint, paid debt carries a variable interest rate and free debt is 0% but can be redeemed against your collateral. Liquidations carry a penalty of up to 10%.
